pages.observed: Option a, 0.0 to 0.8 s. Static wide of an oil pad: closed grey drone dock left, horizontal tank, tall ladder tank at right edge, distant turbines. Caption 'In the Permian Basin,' appears at 0.2 s. Dock lid panels open at 0.6 to 0.8 s exposing a white drone.

Option a, 1.0 to 1.8 s. Same static wide of the pad. Dock lids are open, small white drone sits on the dock without lifting. Caption changes at 1.8 s to 'Chevron tested autonomous drones from a company located in Austin.' Upper half of frame is empty sky.

Option a, 2.0 to 2.8 s. Two Texas outline cards appear (large upper-left, small upper-right), neither shows pins yet. Drone lifts off the open dock at about 2.4 s and climbs above the tank by 2.8 s with blurred rotors. Caption 'Chevron tested autonomous drones from a company located in Austin.' holds.

Option a, 3.0 to 3.8 s. Drone airborne; at 3.2 s framing shifts so the drone hovers center above the horizontal tank and the tall ladder tank sits fully at right. Upper-right small Texas card draws its outline stroke. Large upper-left Texas card is a blank fill. No Austin or Permian pin is visible yet.

Option a, 4.0 to 4.8 s. Drone hovers above the horizontal tank. Large upper-left Texas card shows a pin in west Texas labeled 'Permian Basin' with a short dashed line starting from it at 4.6 to 4.8 s. A second small Texas outline card sits upper-right. Caption about Chevron and Austin holds.

Option a, 5.0 to 5.8 s. Locator card completes: Permian Basin pin in west Texas and Austin pin in central Texas joined by a dashed line. Small upper-right Texas card gets a circle marker at 5.8 s. Drone hovers center above the tank; the shot is still the same wide pad composition.

Option a, 6.0 to 6.8 s. Last pad frame at 6.0 s, then hard cut at 6.2 s to an office: a large dark monitor on a brown desk before a window onto flat land, with a yellow hard hat, blue mug and pen. Screen stays dark until faint header text appears at 6.8 s. Caption 'The companies say AI alerts' from 6.4 s.

Option a, 7.0 to 7.8 s. Monitor lights with a 'Survey flight' panel: a small khaki map tile with a dashed route and drone icon, and a status list reading Battery, Link, Pump pressure. Panel stays essentially static through 7.8 s. Desk props unchanged. Caption 'The companies say AI alerts'.

Option a, 8.0 to 8.8 s. On the monitor a small blue flag rises on the Pump pressure status row and by 8.8 s reads 'Anomaly' as the frame pushes in slightly. Caption switches to 'when it detects anomalies to normal operations.' at 8.4 s. Flag is small relative to frame.

Option a, 9.0 to 9.8 s. Medium framing of the monitor. The blue 'Anomaly' tag sits on the Pump pressure row; the small map icon drifts along its dashed route. No attribution tag reading 'the companies say' appears in these samples. Caption holds 'when it detects anomalies to normal operations.'

Option a, 10.0 to 10.8 s. A pale paper tag reading 'The companies say' slides in from the right across the monitor, passes over the Anomaly flag, and comes to rest at the lower-left of the screen over the map tile, separate from the flag. The Anomaly tag on Pump pressure is visible again at 10.8 s.

Option a, 11.0 to 11.8 s. The 'The companies say' tag settles at the bottom of the monitor near the Anomaly row. At 11.6 s cut to the desk without the monitor; a tilted paper card headed 'Approval letter' slides in from lower right already carrying a small 'Periodic methane screening' tag. Disclosure changes to 'Illustration of the method in EPA's letter'. Caption 'On September 30th, 2025,'.

Option a, 12.0 to 12.8 s. The 'Approval letter' card slides from the right to the center of the desk and straightens; placeholder grey text lines begin to appear on it at 12.6 to 12.8 s. The small 'Periodic methane screening' tag is already printed on it. Caption 'On September 30th, 2025,'. No stamp yet.

Option a, 13.0 to 13.8 s. Same desk shot; the letter's placeholder text lines continue to fill in. The caption changes to 'the Environmental Protection Agency approved' and its bar overlaps the letter's lower edge. No date stamp lands in this interval.

Option a, 14.0 to 14.8 s. A wooden hand stamp drops from above onto the letter's header line; at 14.4 s the framing pushes in to a medium view. At 14.6 to 14.8 s the stamp sits on the letter covering the heading, with a thin colored mark beginning to show beneath. No readable date text visible yet.

Option a, 15.0 to 15.8 s. The stamp lifts away leaving a crooked amber impression reading 'September 30th, 2025' under the 'Approval letter' heading. The letter holds static from 15.4 s. Caption changes to 'that company's Air Max drone system'. The impression text is small at phone size.

Option a, 16.0 to 16.8 s. Static hold on the stamped letter for about one second (16.0 to 16.6 s) while the caption reads 'that company's Air Max drone system'. At 16.8 s the bottom edge of another brown stamp begins entering from the top of frame. No drone or Air Max picture appears during this clause.

Option a, 17.0 to 17.8 s. Cut to a close shot where the letter fills the frame and the amber 'September 30th, 2025' stamp is clearly legible. A brown stamp block slides in from the right and lands beside the 'Periodic methane screening' tag; by 17.8 s an amber edge peeks around it but no approved mark is revealed yet. Background behind letter is blurred grassland.

Option a, 18.0 to 18.8 s. The stamp block lifts off revealing an amber check mark labeled 'Approved' beside the 'Periodic methane screening' tag, then exits top right. The finished letter (date stamp, screening tag, Approved mark) holds through 18.8 s with caption 'for periodic methane screening.' Caption briefly absent at 18.0 s.

Option a, 19.0 to 19.8 s. The completed letter holds static for about 0.8 s, then at 19.8 s a hard cut returns to the well pad wide with the drone hovering above the equipment. The pad frame is smaller in scale (equipment in a band across the middle, lower half empty caliche). No caption at 19.6 to 19.8 s.

Option a, 20.0 to 20.8 s. Pad wide with the drone hovering center. From 20.4 s pale thin circles appear near the tall tank and a faint dashed line runs from the drone to them. The camera pod is a small dark shape under the drone; no visible swing of the pod is discernible. Caption 'The drone carries an infrared camera'.

Option a, 21.0 to 21.8 s. Essentially static wide: the drone hovers in place beside three pale overlapping rings and a faint dashed path over the tall tank. No travel of the drone is visible across these five samples. Caption 'The drone carries an infrared camera'.

Option a, 22.0 to 22.8 s. Cut to a closer framing of the drone over the horizontal tank. Large translucent rings and white dashed route lines connect points of interest. The drone tilts and travels right along the dashed route from the first ring toward the next, with the tall tank entering frame right by 22.8 s. Caption changes to 'and follows a flight plan to points of interest.'

Option a, 23.0 to 23.8 s. The drone completes its move along the dashed path and arrives inside the point-of-interest ring next to the tall tank; at 23.4 s that ring brightens to a white outline, and the drone holds inside it through 23.8 s. Valves (blue and red) sit below. Caption 'and follows a flight plan to points of interest.'

Option a, 24.0 to 24.8 s. Drone holds inside the highlighted ring beside the tall tank while framing eases slightly wider at 24.2 s. At 24.8 s a small dark rectangle begins to appear under the drone, the start of an inset. Valves remain small below. Caption 'and follows a flight plan to points of interest.'

Option a, 25.0 to 25.8 s. A dark inset labeled 'Illustrative infrared view' grows from the drone's position and settles upper-left, showing a grey pipe and valve wheel with a warm amber shimmer rising from it. The inset's lower half is an empty dark field. The drone stays in its ring beside the tall tank; caption 'and follows a flight plan to points of interest.'

Option a, 26.0 to 26.8 s. The infrared inset holds on the pad, then at 26.4 s a hard cut to an office: a seated woman inspector at left, one hand touching the edge of a dark monitor headed 'Survey footage'. The screen remains almost empty through 26.8 s. Disclosure changes to 'Illustration of EPA's method, generic inspector'.

Option a, 27.0 to 27.8 s. Survey footage of the illustrated valve with shimmer slides onto the monitor and settles at its left, with a small row of thumbnails at upper right. The inspector remains seated in the same pose, facing the screen, one hand at its edge. Footage frame is small at phone size. Caption 'Then a certified inspector reviews the footage'.

Option a, 28.0 to 28.8 s. Static two-shot of the inspector and the footage on the monitor for about half a second, then her hand moves toward the screen at 28.6 s. At 28.8 s a cut to a closer medium shows her raising a small stylus to the valve shimmer on the footage; her head overlaps the lower footage label. Caption 'Then a certified inspector reviews the footage'.

Option a, 29.0 to 29.8 s. In the medium shot the inspector's raised hand draws a white dashed outline around the shimmer on the footage, the arc growing from the top right down around the plume. Her hand and forearm overlap the valve and part of the shimmer while drawing. Caption changes to 'to identify any emissions,' at 29.6 s.

Option a, 30.0 to 30.8 s. The dashed outline around the shimmer is closed and a green check mark appears where the inspector's hand presses at the outline's lower right. Her arm and hand stay on the check for the rest of the interval; the frame is otherwise steady. Caption 'to identify any emissions,'.

Option a, 31.0 to 31.8 s. Cut at 31.2 s to a close view from behind the inspector's shoulder: her raised hand on the green check on the footage, and a round inset below showing a red valve on a pipe. At 31.6 to 31.8 s a 'Follow-up inspection' paper tag emerges from the check and is pulled up and right by her hand. Caption 'which triggers a follow-up inspection.' from 31.4 s.

Option a, 32.0 to 32.8 s. The 'Follow-up inspection' tag travels down from the green check on the footage and lands on the round inset of the valve below the monitor, covering the red valve wheel, and rests there with the inspector's hand beside it. The green check and dashed outline remain on the footage. Caption 'which triggers a follow-up inspection.'

Option a, 33.0 to 33.8 s. Hold on the 'Follow-up inspection' tag resting on the valve inset with the green check above, then at 33.6 s a cut to a tall page on a stand before the window: grey placeholder lines and, near the bottom, a box labeled 'Protocol title' reading 'Percepto Autonomous OGI UAS & AI Software Alternative Test Method' (last word clipped). The page begins to scroll.

Option a, 34.0 to 34.8 s. The letter page on its stand scrolls upward so the boxed 'Protocol title' reading 'Percepto Autonomous OGI UAS & AI Software Alternative Test Method' moves to the middle of the page and settles. No highlight on 'AI' yet. Caption 'The approval letter mentions AI only in the title of a protocol.'

Option a, 35.0 to 35.8 s. The letter page is static with the protocol title box mid-page for about 0.8 s; at 35.8 s a small amber highlight lands on the letters 'AI' at the start of the title's second line. The highlight is tiny at this wide framing. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 36.0 to 36.8 s. Cut at 36.2 s to a detail view where the page fills the frame and the boxed protocol title is large and readable, with an amber highlight on 'AI' (highlight slightly overruns into the 'S' of Software). Holds without a counter through 36.8 s. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 37.0 to 37.8 s. After a short static hold on the highlighted title, a paper tag reading 'AI appears once, in a title' fades in at 37.4 s and settles tilted just below the title box by 37.8 s. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 38.0 to 38.8 s. Static hold on the highlighted protocol title with the 'AI appears once, in a title' tag for about 0.6 s, then at 38.8 s a cut to the desk and window where a tilted paper tag reading 'Leak reporting by certified third parties' drops in beside a wall calendar pad. Disclosure changes to 'Illustration. A separate program, no drone'. Caption absent at 38.6 to 38.8 s.

Option a, 39.0 to 39.8 s. The 'Leak reporting by certified third parties' tag slowly settles onto the desk with a soft shadow, gradually leveling. The calendar pad at right stays blank. Caption 'EPA also delayed a separate leak reporting program'.

Option a, 40.0 to 40.8 s. Near-static frame: the program tag lies on the desk and the calendar pad shows no date and no flip across all five samples. Caption 'EPA also delayed a separate leak reporting program'. Together with 39.4 to 39.8 s this is roughly 1.4 s with only small settling motion.

Option a, 41.0 to 41.8 s. The tan calendar pad flips up to reveal a page reading 'January 22 2027'; at 41.4 s the framing pushes in to a medium shot so the calendar and the 'Leak reporting by certified third parties' tag are both larger. The flipped page lifts out of frame by 41.8 s. Caption 'EPA also delayed a separate leak reporting program'.

Option a, 42.0 to 42.8 s. The calendar reading January 22 2027 and the program tag hold static; caption changes to 'to January 22nd, 2027,' at 42.4 s. At 42.8 s the edge of an amber bar starts entering from the left side toward the tag.

Option a, 43.0 to 43.8 s. An amber bar reading 'Delayed' slides in from the left and settles across the lower half of the program tag, beside the calendar reading January 22 2027. The composition then holds; caption 'to January 22nd, 2027,' disappears at 43.8 s.

Option a, 44.0 to 44.8 s. Cut to a wider desk shot: the program tag with its Delayed bar at left and a small calendar block at right that flips to 'October 7'. The January 22 2027 calendar is no longer visible. A small white card edge enters at the right edge at 44.8 s. Caption 'and on October 7th said it will propose to rescind it.'

Option a, 45.0 to 45.8 s. A small card headed 'EPA release' slides in and settles next to the October 7 calendar; its heading is tiny at phone size. At 45.8 s a tilted tag reading 'propose to rescind' begins entering from the lower right, partly under the caption bar. The Delayed program tag stays at left.

Option a, 46.0 to 46.8 s. The 'Will propose to rescind' tag travels up from lower right, passing behind the caption bar, and settles beside the program tag. At 46.6 s a cut to a closer view shows the October 7 calendar, EPA release card, the Delayed program tag and the proposal tag pinned overlapping its lower-right corner, unstamped, against a blurred grassland background.

Option a, 47.0 to 47.8 s. Close shot holds on the October 7 calendar, EPA release card, Delayed program tag and the 'Will propose to rescind' tag fastened with a paper clip. At 47.6 to 47.8 s a short dashed blank line draws under the proposal text, leaving it unstamped. Otherwise the frame is static.

Option a, 48.0 to 48.8 s. The proposal tag's dashed outline closes into an empty stamp box, showing the proposal is unstamped. The close composition (calendar, EPA release, Delayed program tag, proposal tag) then holds static; caption disappears at 48.6 s.

Option a, 49.0 to 49.8 s. Close shot: the inspector's raised stylus rests on the green check beside the dashed outline on the survey footage; a small window card at top right shows the well pad with dock and tanks. Little motion beyond a slight pulse of the check. Caption 'Under this approval, a certified inspector confirms the leak.'

Option a, 50.0 to 50.8 s. Same close shot; the stylus has withdrawn slightly to just below the valve and holds there with a small dot at its tip while the green check and dashed outline remain. Very little change across these samples. Caption 'Under this approval, a certified inspector confirms the leak.'

Option a, 51.0 to 51.8 s. After the close hold on the green check, a cut at 51.4 s to a medium shot of the seated inspector facing the monitor showing the confirmed footage. At 51.8 s a very small grey dashed box with a tiny 'AI' label begins to draw in the empty right panel of the monitor. The window card of the pad is no longer visible.

Option a, 52.0 to 52.8 s. In the medium shot an empty white dashed box labeled 'AI' finishes drawing on the right panel of the monitor beside the confirmed footage (outline plus green check) and stays empty. The inspector remains seated facing the screen. Caption changes to 'The letter doesn't say what the AI adds.' at 52.8 s. The AI box is small at phone size.

Option a, 53.0 to 53.8 s. Completely static medium shot: the inspector seated facing the monitor, which shows the confirmed footage with green check and the empty dashed 'AI' box. No change between samples. Caption 'The letter doesn't say what the AI adds.' The drone station is not visible in the window in these frames.

Option a, 54.0 to 54.8 s. Cut to a wide room shot: the seated inspector at left with a hand at the monitor, which shows the confirmed footage and the empty 'AI' box at small size; through the window at right small grey pad equipment (tank and dock shapes) is faintly visible. Frame is static. Caption 'The letter doesn't say what the AI adds.'

Option a, 55.0 to 55.8 s. The wide room shot holds static: inspector seated, monitor with the confirmed footage and empty AI box, and a pale grey drone station shape visible through the window to the right of the monitor. Caption 'The letter doesn't say what the AI adds.' No performed action in this second.

Option a, 56.0 to 56.8 s. Last story frame of the wide room at 56.0 to 56.2 s, then at 56.4 s a cut to a dark credits card with the current Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket' wordmark, 'texasaidocket.com', and a sources list (EPA approval letter September 30th 2025, Methane Super Emitter Program page, EPA release October 7th, DroneLife March 14th 2025) and 'Original authored diagrams, no brand marks'.
Option a, 57.0 to 57.8 s. Static credits card: Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', 'texasaidocket.com', four sources and the illustration note. No change across samples.
Option a, 58.0 to 58.8 s. The same static credits card (Texas AI Docket wordmark, Lone Star flag, texasaidocket.com, sources and illustration note) holds without change.
Option a, 59.0 to 59.8 s. The credits card continues unchanged: Texas AI Docket wordmark, Lone Star flag, texasaidocket.com, four sources and the illustration note.
Option a, 60.0 to 60.8 s. Credits card holds unchanged with the Texas AI Docket wordmark, Lone Star flag, texasaidocket.com, the four sources and the illustration note.

Option a, 61.0 to 61.3 s (final frame 1839). The credits card stays unchanged to the end of the film: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, four sources and the illustration note.

Option b, 0.0 to 0.8 s. Visually the same opening wide as option a: closed grey dock beside a horizontal tank and tall ladder tank on caliche; dock lids open at 0.6 to 0.8 s revealing a white drone. Caption 'In the Permian Basin,' from 0.2 s.

Option b, 1.0 to 1.8 s. Same as option a: open dock with the drone sitting on it, wide static pad composition; caption changes at 1.8 s to 'Chevron tested autonomous drones from a company located in Austin.'

Option b, 2.0 to 2.8 s. Identical to option a in this interval: two Texas outline cards appear (large upper-left, small upper-right), and the drone lifts off the dock and climbs above the tank by 2.8 s.

Option b, 3.0 to 3.8 s. Same as option a: drone airborne, framing shifts at 3.2 s so drone hovers above the horizontal tank with the tall tank at right; upper-right Texas card draws its outline. No pins yet.
Option b, 4.0 to 4.8 s. Same as option a: drone hovers above the tank; the locator card gets a west Texas pin labeled 'Permian Basin' with a dashed line beginning at 4.6 to 4.8 s.

Option b, 5.0 to 5.8 s. Same as option a: the locator completes with Permian Basin and Austin pins joined by a dashed line; the small card gains a circle marker at 5.8 s; drone hovers over the tank in the same wide composition.

Option b, 6.0 to 6.8 s. Same as option a: last pad frame then hard cut at 6.2 s to the office desk with a dark monitor, hard hat, mug and pen; faint 'Survey flight' header at 6.8 s. Caption 'The companies say AI alerts'. No inspector visible.
Option b, 7.0 to 7.8 s. Same as option a: the monitor lights with the 'Survey flight' map tile and status rows (Battery, Link, Pump pressure) and holds. Desk props unchanged.

Option b, 8.0 to 8.8 s. Same as option a: a blue 'Anomaly' flag rises on the Pump pressure row while the frame pushes in slightly at 8.8 s. Caption 'when it detects anomalies to normal operations.' from 8.4 s.
Option b, 9.0 to 9.8 s. Same as option a: medium framing of the monitor with the 'Anomaly' flag on the Pump pressure row; small map icon drifts on its route; no 'the companies say' tag yet.
Option b, 10.0 to 10.8 s. Same as option a: the 'The companies say' tag slides in from the right, passes over the Anomaly flag and settles at the lower left of the screen over the map tile.

Option b, 11.0 to 11.8 s. The companies-say tag holds at the monitor's bottom edge; then at 11.6 s, unlike option a, the cut shows a wide room with a seated woman inspector at the left holding a pen, while the 'Approval letter' card slides in tilted from the lower right toward her desk. Disclosure becomes 'Illustration of EPA's method, generic inspector'.

Option b, 12.0 to 12.8 s. In the wide room the 'Approval letter' card slides across the desk toward the seated inspector and straightens; first text lines appear at 12.6 to 12.8 s. The inspector holds a pen with arms forward in a fixed pose. Letter and its tag text are small. Caption 'On September 30th, 2025,'.

Option b, 13.0 to 13.8 s. The approval letter fills with grey text lines in front of the seated inspector, who stays in the same pose with pen near the letter. Caption changes to 'the Environmental Protection Agency approved'. No stamp yet. The letter heading and tag text are small at phone size.

Option b, 14.0 to 14.8 s. Cut to a medium view of the approval letter on the desk (inspector out of frame, her pen lies at left). A wooden stamp descends and lands on the letter's heading at 14.6 s; an outlined impression starts to show at 14.8 s. Screening tag text is readable at this size. Caption 'the Environmental Protection Agency approved'.

Option b, 15.0 to 15.8 s. The stamp lifts away to reveal a crooked amber 'September 30th, 2025' impression under the heading; letter then holds with the caption 'that company's Air Max drone system'. No drone or Air Max picture during this clause.

Option b, 16.0 to 16.8 s. Letter holds static on the desk for about 0.8 s, then at 16.8 s a close shot fills the frame with the letter (readable date stamp and screening tag) while the inspector appears in the lower left, raising her pen toward the letter, and a brown stamp block enters top right. The inspector's head sits partly behind the caption bar.

Option b, 17.0 to 17.8 s. Close shot of the letter: the brown stamp block slides in from the right and settles beside the 'Periodic methane screening' tag. The inspector remains in the lower left with pen raised beneath the letter, partly hidden by the caption bar; she does not hold or press the stamp. Caption 'that company's Air Max drone system'.

Option b, 18.0 to 18.8 s. The stamp lifts to reveal an amber checked 'Approved' mark beside the 'Periodic methane screening' tag and leaves top right; the letter holds. The inspector stays at lower left with her pen raised toward the letter, looking up at it. Caption 'for periodic methane screening.' from 18.2 s.

Option b, 19.0 to 19.8 s. The completed letter holds static with the inspector at lower left; at 19.8 s a cut shows a room where the seated inspector faces a wall-mounted screen that shows the drone hovering over the pad with dock and tanks, next to a plain window. No caption at 19.6 to 19.8 s.

Option b, 20.0 to 20.8 s. Room shot with the seated inspector and a wall screen showing the drone over the pad; faint point-of-interest rings and dashes appear on the screen at 20.6 to 20.8 s. The drone and rings on the screen are very small at phone size. Inspector is static, facing right. Caption 'The drone carries an infrared camera'.

Option b, 21.0 to 21.8 s. Room shot holds static for about 0.8 s with the tiny wall-screen drone and rings; at 21.8 s a cut goes to a close outdoor view of the drone (camera pod visible) inside a translucent point-of-interest ring, with white dashes leading to the next ring above the horizontal tank. Caption 'The drone carries an infrared camera'.

Option b, 22.0 to 22.8 s. Close outdoor view essentially matching option a's route shot: the drone hovers in the first ring, then at 22.6 to 22.8 s tilts and travels right along the white dashed flight path toward the next ring, with the tall tank entering frame right.

Option b, 23.0 to 23.8 s. Same as option a: drone arrives inside the point-of-interest ring beside the tall tank; the ring brightens white at 23.4 s and the drone holds there. Caption 'and follows a flight plan to points of interest.'

Option b, 24.0 to 24.8 s. After the outdoor drone frame, a cut at 24.2 s shows the inspector in the lower-left foreground facing a large wall screen that shows the same drone in its highlighted ring by the tall tank. At 24.8 s a small dark square opens under the drone on the screen. Inspector's head overlaps the screen's lower-left corner.

Option b, 25.0 to 25.8 s. On the wall screen an 'Illustrative infrared view' inset of a valve with a warm shimmer grows from beside the drone and settles over the left half of the screen; the drone stays visible in its ring at right. The inspector sits in the lower-left foreground facing the screen with her pen, unchanged. Inset's lower half is empty dark.

Option b, 26.0 to 26.8 s. The wall screen with the infrared inset holds, then at 26.4 s a cut to a desk room where the inspector, seated left, extends her arm to the edge of a mostly dark monitor headed 'Survey footage' (mirrored layout of option a's review shot). Caption 'Then a certified inspector reviews the footage'.

Option b, 27.0 to 27.8 s. Survey footage of the valve and shimmer slides onto the monitor in the desk room while the seated inspector keeps her arm extended to the monitor edge. Footage is small at phone size. Caption 'Then a certified inspector reviews the footage'.

Option b, 28.0 to 28.8 s. Two-shot holds static, then at 28.6 s a closer medium shows the inspector raising a stylus toward the shimmer on the survey footage. Visually equivalent to option a's same interval. Caption 'Then a certified inspector reviews the footage'.

Option b, 29.0 to 29.8 s. Same as option a: the inspector's stylus traces a white dashed outline around the shimmer on the footage; her hand overlaps the valve and plume while drawing. Caption 'to identify any emissions,' from 29.6 s.

Option b, 30.0 to 30.8 s. Same as option a: the outline around the shimmer is closed and a green check appears under the inspector's hand; the frame then holds with her hand on the check. Caption 'to identify any emissions,'.

Option b, 31.0 to 31.8 s. Close view from behind the inspector: her hand on the green check, a round valve inset below the monitor. A 'Follow-up inspection' tag emerges from the check at 31.6 s and is pulled away by her hand at 31.8 s. Equivalent to option a's same interval except the cut timing (b already in close at 31.0 s).

Option b, 32.0 to 32.8 s. Same as option a: the 'Follow-up inspection' tag travels from the green check down onto the round valve inset, covering the red valve wheel, and rests there with the inspector's hand beside it.

Option b, 33.0 to 33.8 s. Hold on the follow-up tag resting on the valve inset, then at 33.6 s a cut to the room where the seated inspector at left faces a tall letter page on a stand; near its bottom a 'Protocol title' box reads 'Percepto Autonomous OGI UAS & AI Software Alternative Test'. Disclosure stays 'Illustration of EPA's method, generic inspector'.

Option b, 34.0 to 34.8 s. The letter page scrolls so the 'Protocol title' box rises to mid-page and settles; the seated inspector at lower left faces it with her pen, static. Caption 'The approval letter mentions AI only in the title of a protocol.'

Option b, 35.0 to 35.8 s. Room shot holds static for about 0.8 s with the inspector facing the page; at 35.8 s a cut to a detail view where the protocol title box is large and the 'AI' in its second line already carries an amber highlight. Caption unchanged.
Option b, 36.0 to 36.8 s. Same as option a: static detail of the highlighted protocol title (highlight overruns into 'S'); no counter tag yet; caption unchanged.
Option b, 37.0 to 37.8 s. Same as option a: the 'AI appears once, in a title' tag fades in at 37.4 s and settles tilted under the highlighted protocol title.

Option b, 38.0 to 38.8 s. Same as option a: static hold on the highlighted title and the 'AI appears once' tag, then a cut at 38.8 s to the desk where the 'Leak reporting by certified third parties' tag drops in beside a calendar pad. No inspector visible in this desk shot.
Option b, 39.0 to 39.8 s. Same as option a: the program tag slowly settles onto the desk beside the blank calendar pad. Caption 'EPA also delayed a separate leak reporting program'.

Option b, 40.0 to 40.8 s. Same as option a: near-static desk with the program tag lying flat and a blank calendar pad; no flip in these samples. Caption 'EPA also delayed a separate leak reporting program'.
Option b, 41.0 to 41.8 s. Same as option a: the calendar flips to January 22 2027 and the framing pushes in to a medium shot of the calendar and program tag.
Option b, 42.0 to 42.8 s. Same as option a: calendar and program tag hold static; caption becomes 'to January 22nd, 2027,'; an amber bar edge enters from the left at 42.8 s.
Option b, 43.0 to 43.8 s. Same as option a: the amber 'Delayed' bar slides onto the program tag beside the January 22 2027 calendar and holds; caption disappears at 43.8 s.
Option b, 44.0 to 44.8 s. Same as option a: wider desk shot, calendar block flips to October 7 beside the Delayed program tag; a card edge appears at right at 44.8 s.

Option b, 45.0 to 45.8 s. Same as option a: a small 'EPA release' card slides in next to the October 7 calendar; a 'propose to rescind' tag enters from lower right at 45.8 s, partly below the caption bar.

Option b, 46.0 to 46.8 s. Same as option a: the proposal tag passes behind the caption bar and settles; at 46.6 s a closer shot shows calendar, EPA release, Delayed program tag and the 'Will propose to rescind' tag over a blurred grassland background.

Option b, 47.0 to 47.8 s. Same as option a: close hold on the clipped 'Will propose to rescind' tag on the Delayed program tag with calendar and EPA release; a dashed blank line draws under the proposal text at 47.6 to 47.8 s.
